sloka: अहो बलमहो वीर्यमहो गाम्भीर्यमेव च ।येनाहं पशुवद्गृह्य भ्रामितश्चतुरो ऽर्णवान् ।। ७.३४.३७ ॥
transliteration: aho balamaho vīryamaho gāmbhīryameva ca ।yenāhaṁ paśuvadgṛhya bhrāmitaścaturo 'rṇavān ।। 7.34.37 ॥

translations.english: Ravana exclaimed, "Oh, what strength, what valor, and what profundity, by which I was seized like an animal and carried around all four oceans!"
